text: China reported 27% year-over-year export growth and 36% import growth in June. Export strength was concentrated in semiconductors, rare earths, autos, and ships, while other categories remained comparatively weaker. AI-linked manufacturing and external shipments remained prominent alongside differentiated domestic demand conditions.

meta.note: The report combines aggregate trade data with sector detail; only the contemporaneous trade structure is logged.

text: Warren Buffett directed this year's Berkshire Hathaway share donations to four family-linked foundations and did not allocate shares to the Gates Foundation. Annual charitable share distributions continued under a revised recipient allocation while the stated long-term share disposal plan remained in place.

meta.note: The distribution change is logged without classifying the external review referenced in the report.

text: The U.S. Consumer Price Index declined 0.4% in June, with the annual rate at 3.5%. Core inflation was unchanged for the month at 2.6% year over year. Energy prices registered the largest monthly decline among major components, while services and shelter remained comparatively stable.

meta.note: The report presents simultaneous divergence between headline and core inflation measures without resolving their relationship.

text: IBM issued preliminary second-quarter results below market expectations as enterprise spending shifted toward servers, storage, and memory hardware. Software and infrastructure revenue performance diverged from AI-linked hardware demand. IBM shares declined 23% during the trading session.

meta.note: The earnings release and market repricing are treated as a single contemporaneous structural observation.

text: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh presented a revised institutional policy framework centered on inflation and announced five internal task forces reviewing communications, technology, the balance sheet, economic data, and inflation practices. The Federal Reserve continued operating under existing monetary authority while internal policy review structures became active.

meta.note: The entry captures institutional configuration rather than the prospective effects of announced policy changes.

text: JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, Goldman Sachs, and Citigroup each reported second-quarter results exceeding market expectations on the same reporting day. Trading, investment banking, and capital markets activity showed broad strength across institutions. AI-related investment activity was reported across multiple firms.

meta.note: Institution-specific differences are omitted to preserve a single cross-sector structural snapshot.

text: The United States withdrew its proposed 20% transit protection fee and stated that Gulf state trade and investment arrangements would replace it. The announced naval blockade against Iranian shipping remained in effect. Maritime traffic through the Strait of Hormuz continued under competing operational control claims.

meta.note: The fee revision and blockade status were contemporaneous; neither resolves the underlying control claims.
